about.title: About us
about.lead: ShojaShapta collects real people's experiences of where to eat what in Bangladesh.

s1.p: “Where can I get good doi?” is usually answered by someone you know. ShojaShapta keeps those answers in one place for everyone: people tell us how it was, and others go with that trust.

s2.p: No stars or scores. People who ate there say whether they loved it, found it okay, or did not like it. Facts like the address, price and whether it is open are checked by others, and we show when something may be out of date.

s3.p: We never push a shop up for money and never make up reviews or ratings. The Famous for lists are picked by editors, not ratings, and every page says so.

s4.p: A shop missing? Saw something wrong? Sign in with Google to add a place or send a correction. Every contribution earns passport points and district stamps.

policy.title: Privacy and rules
policy.lead: We keep only what we need. What we keep and why, in plain words.

s1.p: When you sign in with Google we receive your name, photo and email. The email is never shown to anyone. Your name and the experiences, comments and photos you add are public.

s2.p: Sign-in lets each person share one experience per food and helps us stop abuse. It is not for showing ads or selling your data.

s3.p: You are responsible for the photos and comments you add. Do not post other people's photos, or anything offensive or false. We may hide or remove content after a report, and repeated rule-breaking can lead to a ban.

s4.p: A few cookies and browser storage keep you signed in and remember your theme. There are no advertising cookies and no personal tracking.

s5.p: To delete your account and data, tell us at the address below and we will remove it as soon as we can.
